newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens to service UBS network.
newsitem.headline: Siemens to service UBS network.

text.p: Siemens AG's network systems unit said on Wednesday it had won a contract to service the worldwide data network of Union Bank of Switzerland.
Siemens AG Network Systems, based in Munich, will carry out 24-hour maintenance of UBS network at 14 centres, including Sydney, Hong Kong, Tokyo and New York, a statement said.
UBS is Switzerland's largest universal bank, with 324 branches and subsidiaries in Switzerland and 69 branches, units and representative offices abroad.
Siemens' Network Systems group provides voice, data and video transmission services. Sales exceeded $600 million in the 1994-95 business year.
No price for the contract was published.
